blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
No one wanted to speak Berber to me.
blocks.note: لم يرغب أحد في محادثتي بالأمازيغية.

blocks.text: Do you want to speak Berber like me?
blocks.note: هل تريد أن تتكلم الأمازيغية مثلي؟

blocks.text: Let's talk about the Berber language.
We all speak Berber as a first language.
Ziri won't be able to understand Berber.
blocks.note: لن يقدر زيري على فهم الإمازيغية.

blocks.text: Sami is Berber but he can't speak Berber.
blocks.note: سامي أمازيغي لكن لا يستطيع التحدث بالأمازيغية.

blocks.text: I can understand Berber but can't speak it.
blocks.note: أستطيع فهم الأمازيغية لكن لا أستطيع تكلمها.

blocks.text: If you love the Berber language, go to Algeria.
blocks.note: إن كنت تحب اللغة الأمازيغية، فاذهب إلى الجزائر.

blocks.text: If you speak to him in Berber, he won't understand.
What would have happened if Yanni couldn't understand Berber?
blocks.note: مذا كان سيحدث لو لم يكن ياني يفهم الأمازيغية؟

blocks.text: Only a few people here know that Tom and Mary are from Boston.
blocks.note: فقط أناس قليلون هنا يعرفون أن توم وماري من بوسطن.

sentences.t: We haven't got water.
I haven't told Tom yet.
Haven't you got any money?
I haven't found your book.
I haven't seen you in years.
They haven't come back home yet.
We haven't seen what we need to see.
sentences.ar: لم نرى ما كنا نريد أن نراه.

sentences.t: I still haven't found what Tom asked me to look for.
sentences.ar: لم أجد بعد ما طلبه مني توم.

sentences.t: Say it in English.
You speak English.
I can speak English.
Do you speak English?
Can you speak English?
I don't speak English.
Let's speak in English.
Can't you speak English?
Does anyone speak English?
She doesn't speak English.
You like English, don't you?
sentences.ar: أنت تحب اللغة الإنجليزية ، أليس كذلك؟
